# 0) Configuration

```{r}
out_dir <- here("data_out", "OBISwoaFishBase")

# OBIS x WOA x FishBase state-space counts
tO2_obis_cell_csv <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "binOccurrencesCell__dT_0.50C__dO2_0.50kPa__T_0_30__pO2_0_30.csv"
)
stopifnot(file.exists(tO2_obis_cell_csv))

# WOA files used to define which T-pO2 states actually exist in the ocean
cfg <- list()
cfg$LOCAL_PATH    <- "/../environment/"
PATH              <- paste0(here(), cfg$LOCAL_PATH)
cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE  <- paste0(PATH, "data_out/woa18_all_pO2_kPa_an01.csv")
cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE <- paste0(PATH, "data/woa18_95A4_t00an01.csv")

stopifnot(file.exists(cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE))
stopifnot(file.exists(cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE))

# Load OBIS state-space table
tO2_obis_cell <- readr::read_csv(tO2_obis_cell_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("group","mass_bin","T_bin","O2_bin","n") %in% names(tO2_obis_cell)))

# Plot resolution (can be >= stored resolution)
plot_dT  <- 1.0
plot_dO2 <- 1.0

# Axes ranges
T_range  <- c(0, 30)
O2_range <- c(0, 30)

# pO2_act analysis settings
target_group <- "epipelagic"
T_lo <- 5
T_hi <- 15
Q_low <- 0.01
k_min <- 0
k_max <- 6
min_total_weight <- 200

# Two candidate masses to display in the epipelagic panel
mass_levels_ex <- c("10^1 g", "10^5 g")
mass_labels_ex <- c("10^1~g", "10^5~g")
```

```{r}
woa_temp <- readr::read_csv(cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)
woa_po2  <- readr::read_csv(cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE,  show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# 1) Plotting

## a) Helpers

```{r}
# --- Aesthetics ---
scale_fill_blue_counts <- function(fill_title = "Occurrences",
                                   na.value = "white",
                                   guide = legend_bar_guide()) {
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#67A5CA", high = "#251A2D",
    trans = "log10",
    name = fill_title,
    na.value = na.value,
    guide = guide
  )
}

th <- theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)

# --- WOA reshape helper: pivot all non-coordinate columns ---
woa_wide_to_long <- function(df, value_name) {

  depth_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE"))

  if (length(depth_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No depth columns found. Columns are: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
  }

  df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(depth_cols),
      names_to = "depth_col",
      values_to = value_name
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      depth_m = readr::parse_number(depth_col)
    ) %>%
    select(-depth_col)
}

# --- Bin-center helper ---
to_bin_center <- function(x, binwidth, xrng) {
  x2 <- pmin(pmax(x, xrng[1]), xrng[2] - 1e-10)
  floor((x2 - xrng[1]) / binwidth) * binwidth + xrng[1] + binwidth/2
}

# --- Complete regular T-pO2 grid ---
make_PT_grid <- function(dT = 1.0, dO2 = 1.0,
                         T_range = c(0, 30), O2_range = c(0, 30)) {
  tidyr::crossing(
    T_bin  = seq(T_range[1]  + dT/2,  T_range[2]  - dT/2,  by = dT),
    O2_bin = seq(O2_range[1] + dO2/2, O2_range[2] - dO2/2, by = dO2)
  )
}

# --- Coarsen bins: aggregate counts onto coarser bin centers ---
coarsen_PT_bins <- function(df, dT_new = 1.0, dO2_new = 1.0,
                            T_range = c(0,30), O2_range = c(0,30)) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      T_bin2  = to_bin_center(T_bin,  dT_new,  T_range),
      O2_bin2 = to_bin_center(O2_bin, dO2_new, O2_range)
    ) %>%
    group_by(group, mass_bin, T_bin = T_bin2, O2_bin = O2_bin2) %>%
    summarize(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# --- Build WOA occupancy mask in T-pO2 state space ---
build_woa_state_cells <- function(temp_file, po2_file,
                                  dT = 1.0, dO2 = 1.0,
                                  T_range = c(0,30), O2_range = c(0,30)) {

  woa_temp <- readr::read_csv(temp_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  woa_po2  <- readr::read_csv(po2_file,  show_col_types = FALSE)

  temp_long <- woa_wide_to_long(woa_temp, "temp_C")
  po2_long  <- woa_wide_to_long(woa_po2,  "pO2_kPa")

  # optional safety check
  if (!all(c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth_m") %in% names(temp_long))) {
    stop("temp_long is missing required columns")
  }
  if (!all(c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth_m") %in% names(po2_long))) {
    stop("po2_long is missing required columns")
  }

  inner_join(
    temp_long,
    po2_long,
    by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth_m")
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(temp_C),
      is.finite(pO2_kPa),
      temp_C  >= T_range[1], temp_C  <= T_range[2],
      pO2_kPa >= O2_range[1], pO2_kPa <= O2_range[2]
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      T_bin  = to_bin_center(temp_C,  dT,  T_range),
      O2_bin = to_bin_center(pO2_kPa, dO2, O2_range)
    ) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(in_woa = TRUE)
}

# --- Helpers for pO2_act analysis ---
parse_k_from_mass_bin <- function(lbl) {
  as.numeric(sub(".*10\\^(-?\\d+).*", "\\1", as.character(lbl)))
}

weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probs = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  x <- x[ok]
  w <- w[ok]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]
  w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  approx(x = cw, y = x, xout = probs, ties = "ordered")$y
}

weighted_log_quantile_po2 <- function(po2, w, q = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(po2) & po2 > 0 & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  10^(weighted_quantile(log10(po2[ok]), w[ok], probs = q))
}

# --- math-style decade labels for log x-axes ---
label_decades <- function(x) {
  labs <- ifelse(
    is.finite(x) & x > 0,
    paste0("10^", format(log10(x), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)),
    NA_character_
  )
  parse(text = labs)
}
```


# 2) Prepare binned state-space data

```{r}
# Coarsened OBIS state-space counts
tO2_plot <- coarsen_PT_bins(
  tO2_obis_cell,
  dT_new = plot_dT,
  dO2_new = plot_dO2,
  T_range = T_range,
  O2_range = O2_range
)

# WOA environmental occupancy in the same binned T-pO2 space
woa_state_cells <- build_woa_state_cells(
  temp_file = cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE,
  po2_file  = cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE,
  dT = plot_dT,
  dO2 = plot_dO2,
  T_range = T_range,
  O2_range = O2_range
)

# Full grid for plotting
PT_grid <- make_PT_grid(
  dT = plot_dT,
  dO2 = plot_dO2,
  T_range = T_range,
  O2_range = O2_range
)
```


# 3) Analysis: epipelagic pO2_act vs mass

```{r}
df_band <- tO2_obis_cell %>%
  filter(group == target_group) %>%
  mutate(k = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(k), k >= k_min, k <= k_max) %>%
  filter(T_bin >= T_lo, T_bin <= T_hi) %>%
  filter(is.finite(O2_bin), is.finite(n), n > 0)

po2_act_tbl <- df_band %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarize(
    mass_center_g = 10^k,
    total_weight  = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    po2_act_kPa   = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = Q_low),
    po2_med_kPa   = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = 0.50),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_weight >= min_total_weight, is.finite(po2_act_kPa))

po2_act_tbl

po2_act_csv <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  paste0(
    "epipelagic_pO2_act_vs_mass__T_", T_lo, "_", T_hi,
    "C__q_", format(Q_low, scientific = FALSE), ".csv"
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  po2_act_tbl %>%
    select(k, mass_center_g, po2_act_kPa, po2_med_kPa, total_weight),
  po2_act_csv
)

po2_act_csv
```


# 4) Regression summary

```{r}
plot_df <- po2_act_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    log10_m   = log10(mass_center_g),
    log10_tau = log10(po2_act_kPa)
  )

fit <- lm(log10_tau ~ log10_m, data = plot_df)
summary(fit)

a  <- unname(coef(fit)[1])
b  <- unname(coef(fit)[2])
r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
```


# 5) Plots

## a) Mass-scaling, log-log

```{r}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log10_m, y = log10_tau)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(mass center, g)",
    y = paste0("log10(pO2_act, kPa) [weighted log-quantile q=", Q_low, "]"),
    title = paste0("Epipelagic pO2_act mass scaling (T ", T_lo, "–", T_hi, "°C)"),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "a=", signif(a, 3),
      ",  b=", signif(b, 3),
      ",  R²=", signif(r2, 3),
      "  (min total weight per bin = ", min_total_weight, ")"
    )
  ) +
  th
```

# e) Epipelagic two-mass state space with WOA mask

```{r}
# OBIS counts for the two candidate masses
obis_ex <- tO2_plot %>%
  filter(group == "epipelagic", mass_bin %in% mass_levels_ex) %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass_bin, levels = mass_levels_ex, labels = mass_labels_ex)
  ) %>%
  select(mass_lab, T_bin, O2_bin, n)

# Plot table:
# - all T-pO2 cells for each displayed mass
# - mark whether that cell exists anywhere in WOA
# - attach OBIS counts where present
p_gridEx_df <- tidyr::crossing(
  mass_lab = factor(mass_labels_ex, levels = mass_labels_ex),
  PT_grid
) %>%
  left_join(woa_state_cells, by = c("T_bin", "O2_bin")) %>%
  left_join(obis_ex, by = c("mass_lab", "T_bin", "O2_bin")) %>%
  mutate(
    in_woa = !is.na(in_woa)
  )

# Base plot:
# gray = T-pO2 cell not represented anywhere in WOA
# colored = cell has OBIS representatives
# white = cell exists in WOA but has no OBIS representatives for that facet
p_gridEx_base <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = p_gridEx_df %>% filter(!in_woa),
    aes(x = T_bin, y = O2_bin),
    width = plot_dT, height = plot_dO2,
    fill = "grey85"
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = p_gridEx_df %>% filter(in_woa, !is.na(n), n > 0),
    aes(x = T_bin, y = O2_bin, fill = n),
    width = plot_dT, height = plot_dO2
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ mass_lab, labeller = label_parsed) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = T_range, ylim = O2_range) +
  scale_fill_blue_counts("Cells", na.value = "white") +
  labs(
    x = expression("Temperature, " * T * " (" * degree * C * ")"),
    y = expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)"),
    title = paste0(
      "pO2–T state space epipelagic (WOA mask; ΔT=",
      plot_dT, "°C, ΔpO2=", plot_dO2, " kPa)"
    )
  ) +
  th

p_gridEx_base
```

# 2) Analysis

## a) Helpers

```{r}
parse_k_from_mass_bin <- function(lbl) {
  as.numeric(sub(".*10\\^(-?\\d+).*", "\\1", as.character(lbl)))
}

# Weighted quantile for x with weights w
weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probs = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  x <- x[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]; w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  approx(x = cw, y = x, xout = probs, ties = "ordered")$y
}

# pO2_act defined as 10^(Q_q(log10(pO2))) with weights
weighted_log_quantile_po2 <- function(po2, w, q = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(po2) & po2 > 0 & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  10^(weighted_quantile(log10(po2[ok]), w[ok], probs = q))
}
```

## b) Compute

```{r}
df_band <- tO2_obis_cell %>%
  filter(group == target_group) %>%
  mutate(k = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(k), k >= k_min, k <= k_max) %>%
  # temperature band (using T_bin centers)
  filter(T_bin >= T_lo, T_bin <= T_hi) %>%
  filter(is.finite(O2_bin), is.finite(n), n > 0)

po2_act_tbl <- df_band %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarize(
    mass_center_g = 10^k,
    total_weight = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    po2_act_kPa = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = Q_low),
    po2_med_kPa = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = 0.50),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_weight >= min_total_weight, is.finite(po2_act_kPa))

po2_act_tbl
```
